item.title: 8 Skiers Die in Sierra Nevada Avalanche, 6 Rescued, 1 Still Missing
item.description: A Sierra Nevada avalanche killed eight backcountry skiers in California, while a ninth skier, still missing, is presumed dead. Six skiers survived the incident and were successfully extracted by rescuers in what is being called the deadliest avalanche in modern California history.
